model_annotation: Figure 5 shows the dynamics of the number of people with a body mass index (BMI) over the past decade, with the latest data as of the end of 2022. The x-axis represents the years from 2013 to 2022, and the y-axis represents the BMI in millions of people. The line graph shows the trends for different countries, with each country represented by a different color. The countries included are Italy, France, USA, Spain, Germany, Turkey, and India. The graph shows that the number of people with a BMI over 30 has increased in all countries over the past decade, with the highest increase observed in India. The graph also shows that the number of people with a BMI under 18.5 has decreased in all countries over the past decade, with the highest decrease observed in France.
